title: Kindling recipe
description: kindling.json in a recipe folder (<model>/<hardware>/<count>x/<variant>/). tools/build_index.py validates it and copies it into index.json, which the Kindling site renders. Keys not listed here are allowed and passed through.

id.description: Stable slug: the site's card id, the CLI argument (npx @kindlingai/recipe <id>) and the prefix of this recipe's history tags. Recipes adopted from their own repo keep that repo's name.

status.description: experimental and wip get an Experimental tag on the site; retired is left out of the site; external means the recipe lives in source.repo and this folder holds only its card data.

variant.description: Short description of the build, e.g. exlr8 bit201, int4 KV

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the recipe does

weights_commit.description: Hugging Face commit of the checkpoint the recipe boots

engine.description: The engine the recipe runs. tools/check_pin.py keeps it in agreement with compose.yaml.

commit.description: Full commit hash; empty only while a release is pending

pin.description: image: compose.yaml runs the engine's published image, pinned by digest.

source.description: status external only: where the recipe lives. tools/sync_external.py refreshes this file from there.

hidden.description: Leave the card off the site

order.description: Lower sorts first; recipes without it follow, by path

default_config.description: id of the config shown first; its nodes must equal the folder's count

decode.description: Single-stream decode tok/s on the three standard bench/bench.py workloads (512 tokens, T=0, salted per-run tags): code, prose, structured. Put any other workload in decode_extra so headline bars compare like with like. Non-standard keys in decode are deprecated and will be disallowed once off-method recipes are re-measured.

prose.description: Standard prose explanation prompt pool (512 tokens)

decode_extra.description: Single-stream decode tok/s for extra workloads beyond the standard three (e.g. counting, math, long-prompt, or tool-call decode). Kept separate from decode so the site and card headlines compare like with like.

decode_ci95.description: Optional 95% confidence interval [low, high] in tok/s per decode workload (from bench/bench.py).

decode_prompt_tokens.description: Prompt length range [min, max] in tokens as counted by the server across single-stream decode runs.

prefill.description: Cold prefill tok/s (prompt_tokens / TTFT) at each prompt length. Standard bench/bench.py points: 8192, 32768, 131072 (skip any size where context + 1000 > max_context).

concurrency.description: Aggregate tok/s across concurrent 512-token streams of mixed code/prose/structured prompts. Standard bench/bench.py stream counts: 1, 2, 4, 8 (up to max_concurrent).

concurrency_prompt_tokens.description: Prompt length range [min, max] in tokens as counted by the server across concurrent-stream runs.

quality.description: Correctness and quality checks shown on the card. Standard default-config line from bench/bench.py: {"name": "Needle recall", "value": "found at 128K"} (when max_context allows). Complementary checks such as RealMark (RIPAL) or GSM8K/HumanEval also live here.

notes.description: Measurement conditions: date, engine ref/commit, harness and flags (e.g. bench/bench.py default level), GPU clock state, and active settings.
